column3: A bright red paper kite rises and dips in a steady coastal wind above a grassy hill; its long tail ripples continuously while the camera gently tracks the kite and clouds drift in the background.
A glass marble rolls down a shallow wooden ramp, bumps a second marble, and both continue across a sunlit table; the fixed camera clearly shows the collision and the changing directions.
A cyclist rides through a rain-soaked city street and splashes through a puddle while the camera follows from the side; reflections shimmer on the pavement as the wheels keep turning.
